services.desc: Tours launch every day at 9:30 am and 1:30 pm (4 pm tours Wednesday through Saturday and by request) (Approx. 2 hours total, may go up to 2.5) All guided tours are just $59/person, $49 for children 10 and under. Call for group rates for 8 or more people.
